title: Child car seat requirements
question: When is a child car seat required in Poland?
short_answer: Children under 150 cm must use an approved child restraint system (fotelik).
conditions: Children under 150 cm must use an approved child restraint system
Car seat must be approved to ECE R44 or R129 (i-Size) standard
Rear-facing seats recommended for children up to 4 years
Child under 150 cm cannot sit in the front passenger seat if the airbag is active
If the car has no back seat, child may sit in front with airbag deactivated
exceptions: Taxis: children may travel without a car seat on short journeys (under local regulations)
Emergency medical transport: different rules apply
penalties: Fine: 150 PLN for transporting a child without a proper car seat

sources.title: Prawo o ruchu drogowym – Sejm RP
